label: models/fw_console.mdl: a control console, waist high, dials, two screens, a row of switches

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/sentry.mdl, models/w_egon.mdl, models/filecabinet.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked C, D, C, A where the asset was D, B, B, D: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Checked against the brief's words (a waist-high control console): the outline is a box about 42 units high with a flat slab top, and it is the same in all six side views and the front-left, front-right, back-left and back-right angles. Nothing sticks out or is missing. The silhouette reads as a cabinet with no sloped control face, but the brief does not ask for one.

M2.reason: Measured 44 x 30 x 42 against a brief height of 40 (sizeOff 0.05). The height is 5% over and within the 15% band, so the size matches the brief.

M3.reason: The brief's parts are dials (round), two screens, and a row of switches. The two dark screens are on the front face and the row of six black switch slots is at the bottom of the front. The four amber 'dials' on the front are square, not round, so a round part has the wrong number of sides (4 against a circle), which caps M3 at 1. A small part missing or a round part with the wrong number of sides makes M3 at most 1.

M4.reason: The brief gives no exact colours, only the palette: grey-green painted steel, dark glass-like screens, yellow and black hazard stripe. The front, sides and top use those, and the stripe is yellow and black on the base and top edge. Each region reads as its material.

M5.reason: The hazard stripe is at the base (front and right) and along the top right edge. Wear shows at the edges and the concrete cap has speckle. The screens are dark panels with no content and the dials are flat squares, but the brief does not ask for more than these markings, so nothing asked for is missing.

M6.reason: Capped by the line-up test, which was run apart from this judging. The asset was passed for one of the game's in all four readings (asset at D, B, B, D; judges picked C, D, C, A, none of them the asset).

M7.reason: The front, with the two screens, the dials and the switch row, faces the viewer and is upright. The box stands on its base with the hazard stripe at floor level, as a console stands on its origin.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reports no errors. It has 24 triangles, far under twice the Half-Life median of 238. Every view shows closed faces: the underside (Below) is closed, the back is closed, and the top slab sits on the body. Nothing is open, inside out or floating.
